display.purpose: Hero headline only; solid ink with a solid-signal accent word, never gradient.

title.purpose: Offer card, process step, and side-panel h3.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy and form fields; 34-62ch measure.

label.purpose: Eyebrow pills, module tags, step numbers, badges; the only positive-tracked, uppercase register.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Default glass panel elevation: outer diffusion plus inner top sheen.

shadows.name: panel-sm
shadows.purpose: Nav bar and lighter-lift glass surfaces.

shadows.name: signal-glow
shadows.purpose: Colored cast under the primary button and signal elements.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: The single system easing (--ease) for lifts, deck rotation, and reveals.

motion.name: lift
motion.purpose: Hover raise on buttons and interactive glass.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: opacity + translateY(26px) over 0.8s, staggered 0.08s per data-d step

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action; signal-gradient glass with an inner top-white line, used once per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font: 650 15px/1.2 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7aa2ff, #4b82ff); padding: 14px 22px; border: none; border-radius: 13px; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(75,130,255,0.55), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.45); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(75,130,255,0.55), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.99); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary quiet action; glass fill with a 1px luminous edge.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font: 650 15px/1.2 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #eef1fb; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.055); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); border-radius: 13px; padding: 14px 22px; -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.09); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.22); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.99); }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: The primary container: frosted pane, 1px luminous edge, top-left specular sheen.
components.html:
Automatisation

Taches repetitives

On automatise ce qui vous fait perdre du temps chaque semaine.
components.css: .ds-glass { position: relative; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.055); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); border-radius: 18px; padding: 28px 26px; color: #eef1fb; -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(150%); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(150%); box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(2,6,22,0.55), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.30); } .ds-glass::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.30), transparent 42%); opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; } .ds-glass h3 { font: 800 22px/1.15 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.03em; margin: 20px 0 0; } .ds-glass p { color: #a7b3d4; font-size: 15.5px; margin-top: 12px; } .ds-oc-tag { display: inline-block; font: 700 12px/1 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: #7aa2ff; padding: 6px 11px; border-radius: 100px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #4b82ff 14%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #4b82ff 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Glass field with a signal focus ring; no default outline.
components.css: .ds-field label { display: block; font: 650 12.5px/1 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #a7b3d4; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; font: 400 15px/1.4 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #eef1fb; padding: 13px 15px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.055); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #717ea6; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #4b82ff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, #4b82ff 22%, transparent); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.09); }

components.name: Glass Nav Pill
components.description: Sticky pill-shaped glass nav bar with gradient brand cube and a signal CTA.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 10px 12px 10px 18px; border-radius: 100px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.055); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(150%); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(150%); box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(2,6,22,0.45); } .ds-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font: 800 19px/1 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: #eef1fb; } .ds-cube { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 6px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7aa2ff, #4b82ff); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(75,130,255,0.55), inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.6); } .ds-nav-cta { font: 650 14px/1 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 100px; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7aa2ff, #4b82ff); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(75,130,255,0.55), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.4); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Eyebrow Pill
components.description: Neutral glass pill with a glowing signal dot; section eyebrow label.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 600 12px/1 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #a7b3d4; padding: 7px 13px; border-radius: 100px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.055); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); } .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #4b82ff; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(75,130,255,0.55); }

components.name: Empty Module Slot
components.description: The signature dashed 'to-be-assembled' block from the hero deck; transparent fill, dashed signal outline, no shadow.
components.html:
+ Votre besoin
Le bloc qui vous manque
components.css: .ds-mod-slot { position: relative; padding: 18px 18px 16px; border-radius: 18px; background: transparent; border: 1.5px dashed #4b82ff; box-shadow: none; transform: rotate(-2deg); } .ds-mod-slot .ds-mod-tag { font: 700 11px/1 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4b82ff; } .ds-mod-slot .ds-mod-label { font: 700 16px/1.15 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin-top: 10px; color: #a7b3d4; }

narrative.overview: myblok is a liquid-glass modular world. Every surface is a frosted pane floating over a deep midnight-navy ground, edged with a single luminous 1px hairline and lit from the top-left. The signature is literal: the hero is a deck of glass service modules floating in real CSS 3D perspective, with a dashed '+ votre besoin' slot clipping in. The mood is sober but dynamic, professional-credible with a controlled dose of startup wow. Color is disciplined to two registers: a near-monochrome blue-tinted navy field and one electric-blue signal that carries every accent, CTA, and highlight. The system ships full light and dark themes with dark as default, both the same world under a different light source.
keyCharacteristics: Deep midnight-navy ground, never pure black; blue-tinted ink, never flat gray.
A single electric-blue signal owns every accent.
Frosted glass panels (backdrop-blur + 1px luminous edge + top-left sheen) as the primary container.
Heavy tight grotesque display type; solid headings, never gradient-filled.
Real 3D perspective staging for the module deck; light source top-left.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one accent hue. Every attention-carrying element is the electric blue. If you need contrast, change lightness within the signal, not the hue.

rules.name: The Never-Black-Never-Gray Rule
rules.body: The ground is midnight-navy (#060a16), never #000. Text is blue-tinted, never neutral gray. The whole field is quietly blue.

rules.name: The Solid-Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings are solid ink or a solid-blue accent word. Never fill a heading with a gradient; gradients belong to buttons, marks, and badges.

rules.name: The Negative-Tracking Rule
rules.body: Display and heading type always carries negative letter-spacing; the larger the size, the tighter. Only labels and eyebrows track positive.

rules.name: The Top-Left Light Rule
rules.body: One light source, top-left, everywhere. Every glass panel gets a 135deg sheen and an inset top highlight. Never light a panel from the bottom.

rules.name: The Lift-On-Hover Rule
rules.body: Raised state is motion, not just color: interactive elements translate up -1px to -2px and deepen their shadow on hover; buttons settle on :active.

dos: Do build every container as a glass panel: glass fill + 1px luminous border + backdrop-blur(20px) saturate(150%) + panel shadow + the top-left ::before sheen.
Do keep the accent to the single electric blue; change lightness when you need accent contrast, never the hue.
Do light everything from the top-left with 135deg sheens and inset top highlights.
Do set headings at weight 800 with negative tracking and keep body copy to a 34-62ch measure.
Do express raised/active state as motion (translateY hover, translateY(1px) scale(0.99) active) plus a deeper glow.
Do reserve dashed signal strokes for the 'empty / to-be-assembled' module meaning.
Do guard every animation behind prefers-reduced-motion and keep tokens theme-agnostic so both light and dark render from the same names.
donts: Don't fill headings with gradients; gradients live on buttons, marks, badges, and the brand cube only.
Don't use pure black for ground or flat gray for text; the field stays blue-tinted.
Don't introduce a second accent hue; the only sanctioned non-signal color is scoped error red on form messages.
Don't draw hard opaque borders; panel edges are the 1px luminous glass hairline.
Don't flatten the hero deck into a static 2D card grid; the real-perspective float is the identity.
Don't collapse the two-register discipline into a generic dark-gradient SaaS hero or a flat freelance card-grid.
